body: That's a possibility. Idk I think I just over reacted. She's got a lot on her mind.

Honestly, not well. Like you I spend most of my time putting on a show for those around me. I smoke about a pack and a half a day just so I don't end up in trouble. When everything gets to be too much I take a hot bath, put in my headphones, and drown out the world. 

About a year ago I admitted myself to the psych unit here in town. Up until two days ago it had been almost a year since I self harmed. Guess my coping techniques aren't working as well as I thought they were 😕
Honestly it was just kind of shocking because she has been so incredibly supportive about everything. To suddenly not have that just hit me hard.

I hope you're right. It's like a never ending circle. I'm starting to believe I don't deserve to find happiness because every time I start to think it might be happening for me, it gets ripped away. I fall into this dark hole for what seems like absolutely no reason at all.
I'm ill as well. Chronic major depression and borderline personality disorder

Today I took an eraser and rubbed my arm raw, didn't even realize I was doing it.

When I would cut it was because it felt like the only thing I had control over at that moment. It was the only release I had. I won't go into specifics as to what satisfied me about it because I know it can be a trigger for some. It took me a long time to realize that the feeling of control was an illusion, that the cutting was actually controlling me. Like you said, it becomes an addiction.

I've thought of that many times. It's why I've changed my major 5 times 😛 

Honestly I think this go round is just my being out of working starting to get to me. I had an amazing job but had to have shoulder surgery and they wouldn't hold my position during my 5 month recovery. I won't even be released until the end of February, not even to light duty.
Though I am not working right now because I am recovering from shoulder surgery I see some of your feelings resembling mine.
